title: Aubergine with Potato Mash
instructions: Wash the aubergine properly. Cut it into identical halves and score the inside into little cubes, about 1-1.5cm wide.
Rub some olive oil on top and into the ridges, season with herbs of the provence, and salt. Insert into baking dish or Remoska cubed side up, skin side down.

Take cherry tomatoes and cut them in half. Slice onion into rings and garlic into chunks. Toss in a bowl with some olive oil, salt and herbs, and add into the baking dish. Do not cover the aubergine though.
Add a little bit of water into the baking dish and bake for a few minutes, until the top of the cubes does not look browned. Then add a slice of cheese on top of the aubergine and cover again.
